description: This Java class defines an abstract base class 'EntityIdWithType' for entity identifiers that are aware of their entity type, providing common functionality such as equality checks, compatibility validation, and string representation. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto project and is located in the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.entity.id' package.

classes.name: EntityIdWithType
classes.description: An abstract base class for entity IDs that include type information, ensuring immutability and providing methods for validation and comparison.

methods.name: EntityIdWithType
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity ID, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: createEqualityValidator
methods.description: Creates a Consumer that validates whether an EntityIdWithType instance matches an expected entity ID.

methods.name: isCompatibleOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if another EntityIdWithType is compatible with this instance, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: getIllegalArgumentExceptionForDifferentEntityIds
methods.description: Generates an IllegalArgumentException indicating two entity IDs are incompatible.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Returns whether the underlying entity ID is a dummy.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare entity ID and entity type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the entity ID and entity type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the entity ID.
